texts: Apparel and footwear items are generally eligible for return within 7 days of delivery when unused and in original condition
Some product listings may show a different seller-specific window.
Order cancellation is possible before dispatch when the order page provides a cancellation option
After dispatch, cancellation may no longer be available and return rules may apply.
For COD orders, an approved refund is processed after the returned item passes the required checks
The refund timeline depends on the selected refund method and banking partner.
A damaged or incorrect item should be reported through the order support flow as soon as possible
Photos or other evidence may be requested during the support process.
Delivery estimates are shown on the order page and can vary by seller, destination, stock and courier capacity
Delays may occur because of weather, operational disruption or remote locations.
Electronics return eligibility depends on the listing and product condition
Defective items should be reported promptly and may require troubleshooting before reverse pickup.
Exchange availability depends on product category, seller policy, stock and size or variant availability
The order page is the final source for exchange eligibility.
Home products are generally eligible for return within 7 days when unused and complete
Large or installation-based products can have additional eligibility conditions.
After a return is approved and processed, refund status can be checked from the order details page
Bank or payment-provider posting time can vary after the refund is initiated.
Returned products should normally be unused, undamaged and accompanied by required accessories, tags or packaging where applicable
Product-specific conditions shown on the listing take precedence.
Reverse pickup is offered when the order and PIN code are eligible and the item meets return conditions
Pickup availability can vary by courier coverage and item type.
Seller-specific return, replacement and warranty conditions can differ from general platform guidance
Customers should check the policy shown on the product and order pages.
